good_thing: (Springdale, Utah): Brent Phillips and his college-age daughter Jordan arrived at Zion National Park with their Angels Landing plans spoiled by flight delays and an unsuccessful permit attempt. After stopping to take a photo for a solo hiker, they later met her group, which had two unused permits and gave them to the pair. Their dream hike was back on, thanks to a small favor that came back around.
current_or_history: On November 17, 1970, the Soviet Luna 17 mission landed in Mare Imbrium and deployed Lunokhod 1, the first wheeled vehicle on the Moon. A five-person ground crew guided the eight-wheeled rover down its ramp; it later worked for 322 Earth days and returned more than 20,000 television images.
tiny_fact: A cephalopod’s brain forms a doughnut-like ring around its esophagus, stretching slightly as food passes through. Octopuses, squid, and cuttlefish also have three hearts.
thought: A good day does not have to go exactly to plan to become one worth remembering.
